Oh, what a gloomy day we're having! Speaking of which, I heard that newspapers used to be the only way people knew if it was going to rain. Imagine waiting for the morning paper to plan your day!

Anyway, about your question - the Daily Universal Register was indeed relaunched in 1788 with a new name that would become one of the most famous newspapers in the world.

Answer: The Times

Confidence: 100%
